qs.q: A researcher working with Ebola virus samples in a laboratory needs to take precautions against potential aerosol transmission. Aside from Ebola, which other virus group is noted for high aerosol transmission?
o: Only Flaviviruses like the Dengue fever virus
Dengue fever virus exclusively and no others
All viral haemorrhagic fever viruses without exception
qs.e: Most viral haemorrhagic fevers have high aerosol transmission except for the dengue fever virus. Filoviruses, Bunyaviruses, and Arenaviruses share this high aerosol transmission risk.

qs.q: When admitting a patient with suspected Ebola virus disease, what specific environmental control should be implemented in the ward?
o: Negative pressure isolation room with air exchanges
Positive pressure room to prevent outside pathogens
Standard open-ward bed placement with separation
Laminar airflow room with ultraviolet irradiation
qs.e: Suspected cases should be isolated in a negative pressure room or single room with 6-12 air exchanges per hr. All contacts require medical surveillance for 21 days.
